title: weighted round robin: weight 1:2 dispatch ratio, no pool/command oversubscription, no starvation

fixed_configuration.criterion: complete feasible round: both commands ready with full weight (1+2); 2*count1-5 <= count2 <= 2*count1+5 over 300 dispatch starts; complete-round environment >=90% is a required precondition
fixed_configuration.normative_note: SCHEDULER: "只有ready且资源可行的command参与" -> work-conserving, no idle wait; "每轮未用credit不跨轮累积"; the 1:2 ratio is owed only for complete feasible rounds.
fixed_configuration.measurement: dispatch start events (unit callable entry), not completions; P>=2 makes completion order differ from dispatch order

tolerance: empirical: ratio in [1.5,2.5] and |count2-2*count1|<=8; frozen in this manifest
